Welcome to Balyseede Castle
Welcome to Ballyseede Castle
4 star Luxury Castle Hotel
Welcome to Ballyseede Castle, where history and luxury intertwine on 30 acres of enchanting private gardens and woodland. Step inside and discover a timeless sanctuary of elegance and tranquillity..
From the moment you pass through the grand entrance adorned with Doric columns, you are greeted by an exquisite oak staircase that sets the tone for the opulence that awaits. Our impressive drawing rooms, with their ornate cornices and marble fireplaces, provide the perfect backdrop for a sumptuous Afternoon Tea or a delightful morning coffee.
The Castle boasts 45 individually designed Bedrooms , ranging from Double Castle Rooms to Elegant Castle Suites , each offering a unique story and unparalleled comfort. Indulge in traditional Irish cuisine, meticulously prepared to provide a culinary experience like no other.
Celebrate your marriage in style in The Belfry, a stunning custom-built 'Church Style' ceremony space within the magnificent estate, just a short walk from the Castle. An enchanting setting, sure to leave a lasting impression on your guests.
Whether you are here for a romantic getaway, a family retreat, or to celebrate a special occasion, Ballyseede Castle promises an unforgettable stay. Discover the magic of Ballyseede Castle, where every moment becomes a cherished memory.
